title: Reject lot acceptance when a required percentage cannot be computed
prompt:
Fix the synthetic reagent lot comparison's false acceptance when the old-lot baseline is zero. Change only lib/ohworks-lot-comparison.ts and add tests/ohworks-lot-percent-evidence.test.ts. Evidence: lib/ohworks-lot-comparison.ts:298-306 makes percentDifference null for zero oldValue and skips the declared percentage limit; lines 323-332 similarly skip unavailable mean percent bias and default to accept. Reproduced with one pair oldValue=0, newValue=100, matching unit u, minPairs=1, allowableDifference={absolute:null,percent:5}, maxMeanDifference=null, maxPercentBias=5, and maxOutlierPairs=0: decision is accept with zero outliers. This can misstate the candidate lot decision in the QC/lot demo.

Reject comparisons whose explicitly required percentage criterion cannot be evaluated, using LotComparisonError with a dedicated, sanitized unavailable-percentage error code. Apply this to both per-pair percentage and aggregate percent-bias criteria. Preserve null percentage outputs when the corresponding percentage criterion is not requested; absolute-only comparisons must continue working. Do not substitute zero for an undefined percentage.

Test zero-baseline pairs, zero aggregate mean from opposing baselines, ordinary nonzero percentages, and absolute-only controls. Assert error class/code and unchanged valid results. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks-lot-percent-evidence.test.ts. The planner reproduced this defect and ran the six relevant existing suites: 140 tests passed. Open PR diffs and recent merged diffs were checked with no overlap. work on the assigned branch you are on. Use synthetic fixtures only; no other file edits or external operations.
